recon.notes: Recon from one live read of each door on 2026-10-18 (nine requests to the host, the sitemaps included; the validation run spent the other three on /tbt, /red and /comedy-show). Bear Jamboree is Orlando's bear weekend in early June — June 4–7 in 2026, June 3–7 in 2027 per the home-page banner — held across the Crowne Plaza (pool parties, Bearoke, the lobby-bar meet & greet), Hyatt Place (Bingo, the comedy show, Bearlicious), the Sheraton Lake Buena Vista (TBT), House of Blues at Disney Springs (RED) and Disney's Typhoon Lagoon (Riptide); it also presents a Sunday Tea Dance at Anthem for Come Out With Pride Orlando in October. Everything dated on this site is an image: the 2027 dates are a banner, the tea dance is a gallery of flyers, and the 2026 party pages print month and day without a year. The audit proposed /tickets as the Wix Events door; on the recon date that page is an empty shell, so the stanza is the root — the home page carries the banner and the nav reaches the tea dance and, via EVENTS → /events, the party pages.

coverage.basis: Text doors publish nothing upcoming: the Wix Events widget carries no event-list section on any of the nine pages read (the parser's own findWixEventListSections returns 0 for each), and every dated text line (/schedule, /tbt, /red, /comedy-show, /riptide) is the past June 2026 edition, fixed to 2026 by its weekdays. The two upcoming things the site publishes are images: the home-page banner "June 3-7,2027" and the three Sunday Tea Dance flyers on /bear-tea-dance ("18 OCT SUNDAY DAY 12PM - 6PM"), both read by the OCR path in run 20261018-115356 and documented from that read — hence medium: the site's remaining gallery images (sponsor logos on every page, the 1,000-image /gallery not read) are assumed to carry no further dated flyer. Past listings: 12 schedule entries and 4 party pages, counted not enumerated.

openQuestions.q: The 2027 weekend is published as a date-only banner; the run's record attached Disney's Typhoon Lagoon (geo-poi) and its coordinates to the whole weekend because the home copy mentions "our legendary Bear Lagoon at Disney's Typhoon Lagoon". A multi-venue weekend announced without a venue should carry none; whether the POI rung may name a bar the page never states for the event is a generic question for the owner.

When the 2027 edition goes on sale the Wix Events widget should carry its events in the warmup blob of every page (the Wix reader reads it from the root). Whether the Tickets page uses the list widget or a single-event ticket picker, whose data the reader does not look for, cannot be known until then — recheck the first run after the announcement.

/schedule is the one text schedule and nothing links it (sitemap only); the crawler does not read sitemaps. If the 2027 schedule is again posted there unlinked, only a configured URL reaches it — owner call whether to add https://www.bearjamboree.com/schedule to urls once dates exist.

The party pages and /schedule disagree on venues for the same 2026 nights (TBT: Sheraton Lake Buena Vista vs Crowne Plaza Lobby Bar; Saturday: RED at House of Blues vs Bearlicious at Hyatt Place). For 2027 the fresher page should win; which that is cannot be known until both are rewritten.
